parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The list of device names whose running status you want to query.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The list of device IDs whose running status you want to query.
><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices whose running status you want to query belong.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
